[SWS_DM_01259] Validation of Security Level Locked in ara::diag::Conversation::GetDiagnosticSecurityLevelShortName
⌈
If the application calls the ara::diag::Conversation::GetDiagnosticSecu-
rityLevelShortName with the parameter securityLevel set to kLocked, the
Diagnostic Server instance shall return error code kInvalidArgument.
